elements.text:
Next, you will see the titles of the nine short stories you just read. After each one, you will see four sentences. None of these sentences are identical to the original story, but some are more similar than others.

Think back to the story you read, and rate how similar each sentence is to what you read in the original story. We are interested in your understanding of the original story, whether or not that matches what you would personally think or do in that situation.
